Columbus Crew fires coach Higuain over sexism accusation

Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew dismissed reserve team coach Federico Higuain on Tuesday, September 23, following an accusation of sexism towards a female referee. The Professional Soccer Referees Association (PSRA) stated that Higuain's offensive remark was, "Don't forget, this is a man's game."
